children: LONDON (dpa-AFX) - Entain Plc (ENT.L), a sports betting and gaming company, Thursday reported a 2% year-over-year increase in group net gaming revenue (NGR) on a constant currency basis in the third quarter of 2026. Growth in the UK and Ireland offset declines in international markets.
Group online NGR increased 3%, while retail NGR declined 2%.
In the UK and Ireland, NGR rose 8%, with online NGR increasing 14% and retail NGR rising 1%.
International NGR declined 4%, as online NGR fell 3% and retail NGR dropped 12%.

Entain reiterated its fiscal 2026 guidance, expecting online NGR growth of 4% to 6% on a constant currency basis and underlying EBITDA, excluding parent fees, to be at the lower end of its £910 million to £960 million forecast range.
On the LSE, Entain shares closed down 0.83% at 444.40p on Wednesday.
